questions.explainKo: 정답: ② still — 미술 수업이 끝났지만 아무것도 그리지 않은 채 Vashti가 '여전히(still)' 자리에 앉아 있었다는 내용이 되어야 한다. ((답지 P152L Reading 실전 문제 pp.42-45 01)
questions.promptEn:
01 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
[01-10] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

Art class was over, but Vashti ⓐ______ sat in her chair. Her paper was blank. Her teacher ⓑleaned over and looked at it.
"Ah! It is a polar bear in a snowstorm," she said.
ⓒ"That's funny!" said Vashti. "I CAN'T draw!"
Her teacher smiled. ⓓ"Just make a mark."
Vashti picked up a marker and drew a small dot on the paper. "Here it is!"
Her teacher picked up the paper and looked at it carefully. "Hmmmm."
She pushed the paper toward Vashti and asked her ⓔ______ it.
Vashti thought ⓕfor a moment.
"Well, maybe I can't draw, but I (A)______ sign my name."

The next day, ⓐVashti was surprised to see something in a frame on the wall of the art classroom. It was her little dot!
"I can make a better dot than ⓑthat!" Vashti said.
She got a brush and ⓒ______.
choices: Vashti didn't care about the dot
Vashti felt surprised during the art class
Vashti expected her classmates to be surprised
Vashti was surprised because she saw something
Vashti already knew her dot was there, so she wasn't surprised
